verses.sloka: अथ रात्र्याम् व्यतीतायाम् विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः ।आपृष्ट्वा तौ च राजानौ जगाम उत्तर पर्वतम् ॥१-७४-१॥
verses.transliteration: atha rātryām vyatītāyām viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ ।āpṛṣṭvā tau ca rājānau jagāma uttara parvatam ॥1-74-1॥

translations.english: Night over, the great ascetic Viswamitra, profusely blessed the princes born in the race of Raghu, took leave of the two kings and set out towards the northern (Himalayas) mountains.

verses.sloka: विश्वामित्रो गते राजा वैदेहम् मिथिला अधिपम् ।आपृष्ट्व इव जगाम आशु राजा दशरथः पुरीम् ॥१-७४-२॥
verses.transliteration: viśvāmitro gate rājā vaideham mithilā adhipam ।āpṛṣṭva iva jagāma āśu rājā daśarathaḥ purīm ॥1-74-2॥

translations.english: With the departure of Viswamitra, king Dasaratha who was the source of happiness to his subjects took leave of Janaka, king of Mithila and speedily set out for the city of Ayodhya.

verses.sloka: अथ राजा विदेहानाम् ददौ कन्या धनम् बहु ।गवाम् शत सहस्राणि बहूनि मिथिलेश्वरः ॥१-७४-३॥
verses.transliteration: atha rājā videhānām dadau kanyā dhanam bahu ।gavām śata sahasrāṇi bahūni mithileśvaraḥ ॥1-74-3॥

translations.english: King Janaka, lord of the Videhas, gave plenty of gifts to his daughters and followed king Dasaratha for some distance on his journey to Ayodhya.

verses.sloka: कंबलानाम् च मुख्यानाम् क्षौमान् कोटि अंबराणि च ।हस्ति अश्व रथ पादातम् दिव्य रूपम् स्वलंकृतम् ॥१-७४-४॥
verses.transliteration: kaṁbalānām ca mukhyānām kṣaumān koṭi aṁbarāṇi ca ।hasti aśva ratha pādātam divya rūpam svalaṁkṛtam ॥1-74-4॥

translations.english: The king of Mithila and father of the brides gave a hundred thousand cows, excellent woollen carpets, crores of silk garments, four divisions of elephants, horses, chariots and infantry and welldecorated, excellent male and maidservants shining in celestial beauty.

verses.sloka: ददौ कन्या शतम् तासाम् दासी दासम् अनुत्तमम् ।हिरण्यस्य सुवर्णस्य मुक्तानाम् विद्रुमस्य च ॥१-७४-५॥
verses.transliteration: dadau kanyā śatam tāsām dāsī dāsam anuttamam ।hiraṇyasya suvarṇasya muktānām vidrumasya ca ॥1-74-5॥

translations.english: The king of Mithila and father of the brides gave a hundred thousand cows, excellent woollen carpets, crores of silk garments, four divisions of elephants, horses, chariots and infantry and welldecorated, excellent male and maidservants shining in celestial beauty.
translations.hindi: ये सब ब्राह्मण आगे चलें । मेरा रथ भी तैयार कराओ जिससे देर न होने पावे । देखो, राजा जनक के दूत जल्द! कर रहे है

verses.sloka: ददौ राजा सुसंहृष्टः कन्या धनम् अनुत्तमम् ।दत्त्वा बहु विधम् राजा समनुज्ञाप्य पार्थिवम् ॥१-७४-६॥
verses.transliteration: dadau rājā susaṁhṛṣṭaḥ kanyā dhanam anuttamam ।dattvā bahu vidham rājā samanujñāpya pārthivam ॥1-74-6॥

translations.english: Immensely delighted, he gave his excellent daughters gold, pearls and corals.
translations.hindi: जब महाराज दशरथ, उक्त ऋषियों के साथ रवाना हुए, तब उनकी आज्ञा से चतुरङ्गिणी सेना उनके पीछे-पीछे चली

verses.sloka: प्रविवेश स्व निलयम् मिथिलाम् मिथिलेश्वरः ।राजा अपि अयोध्या अधिपतिः सह पुत्रैः महात्मभिः ॥१-७४-७॥
verses.transliteration: praviveśa sva nilayam mithilām mithileśvaraḥ ।rājā api ayodhyā adhipatiḥ saha putraiḥ mahātmabhiḥ ॥1-74-7॥

translations.english: The Lord of Mithila bestowed a lot of wealth on his daughters and with the consent of the king (Dasaratha) reentered his residence in Mithila.

verses.sloka: ऋषीन् सर्वान् पुरस्कृत्य जगाम स बल अनुगः ।गच्छंतम् तु नरव्याघ्रम् स ऋषि संघम् स राघवम् ॥१-७४-८॥
verses.transliteration: ṛṣīn sarvān puraskṛtya jagāma sa bala anugaḥ ।gacchaṁtam tu naravyāghram sa ṛṣi saṁgham sa rāghavam ॥1-74-8॥

translations.english: King Dasaratha of Ayodhya also left along with his great sons preceded by the sages and followed by the army.

verses.sloka: घोराः तु पक्षिणो वाचो व्याहरन्ति समंततः ।भौमाः चैव मृगाः सर्वे गच्छन्ति स्म प्रदक्षिणम् ॥१-७४-९॥
verses.transliteration: ghorāḥ tu pakṣiṇo vāco vyāharanti samaṁtataḥ ।bhaumāḥ caiva mṛgāḥ sarve gacchanti sma pradakṣiṇam ॥1-74-9॥

translations.english: While this tiger among men Dasaratha, was returning with the hosts of sages and his sons, he observed here and there frightening birds making disagreeable sounds.

verses.sloka: तान् दृष्ट्वा राज शार्दूलो वसिष्ठम् पर्यपृच्छत ।असौम्याः पक्षिणो घोरा मृगाः च अपि प्रदक्षिणाः ॥१-७४-१०॥
verses.transliteration: tān dṛṣṭvā rāja śārdūlo vasiṣṭham paryapṛcchata ।asaumyāḥ pakṣiṇo ghorā mṛgāḥ ca api pradakṣiṇāḥ ॥1-74-10॥

translations.english: Seeing the beasts on the way rushing to the right the tiger among men, enquired of Vasishta:
translations.hindi: अपने दोनों पराक्रमी राजकुमारों को देख कर, आप परमः प्रसन्न होंगे । यह भी बड़े सौभाग्य की बात है, जो महातेजस्वी भगवान्‌ वसिष्ठ ऋषि

verses.sloka: किम् इदम् हृदय उत्कम्पि मनो मम विषीदति ।राज्ञो दशरथस्य एतत् श्रुत्वा वाक्यम् महान् ऋषिः ॥१-७४-११॥
verses.transliteration: kim idam hṛdaya utkampi mano mama viṣīdati ।rājño daśarathasya etat śrutvā vākyam mahān ṛṣiḥ ॥1-74-11॥

translations.english: "While the frightening birds are inauspicious, the deer on the right are favourables Why is this? My heart beats. My mind is depressed.
translations.hindi: सब ऋषियों के साथ, देवताओं सहित इन्द्र की तरह, यहाँ पधारे हैं | सौभाग्य की बाव है कि, कन्यादान के समय के समस्त विन्न अब नष्ट हो गए ओर मेरा यह प्रतिष्टित कुल भी

verses.sloka: उवाच मधुराम् वाणीम् श्रूयताम् अस्य यत् फलम् ।उपस्थितम् भयम् घोरम् दिव्यम् पक्षि मुखात् च्युतम् ॥१-७४-१२॥
verses.transliteration: uvāca madhurām vāṇīm śrūyatām asya yat phalam ।upasthitam bhayam ghoram divyam pakṣi mukhāt cyutam ॥1-74-12॥

translations.english: To these words of king Dasaratha the great ascetic Vasishta replied in a gentle voice, "I shall tell you the consequences Listen".
translations.hindi: पौरोंमें श्रेष्ठ शौर महात्मा रघुबंशियों के साथ सम्बन्ध होने नसे प्रतिष्ठित हो गया । हे नरेन्द्र! आप कल प्रातःकाल यज्ञान्त- स्नान ( अवभ्वथ ) हो चुक्रने पर, ऋषियों की सम्मति से त्रिवाहा- चार की रीति करावें । इस प्रकार राजा जनक के वचन सुन कर ऋषियों के बीच बैठे हुए महाराजा दशरथ,

verses.sloka: मृगाः प्रशमयन्ति एते संतापः त्यज्यताम् अयम् ।तेषाम् संवदताम् तत्र वायुः प्रादुर् बभूव ह ॥१-७४-१३॥
verses.transliteration: mṛgāḥ praśamayanti ete saṁtāpaḥ tyajyatām ayam ।teṣām saṁvadatām tatra vāyuḥ prādur babhūva ha ॥1-74-13॥

translations.english: The dreadful cries from the mouths of birds foretell an event of celestial nature likely to befall but the movements other of deer indicate restoration of peace. Therefore do not grieve.

verses.sloka: कम्पयन् मेदिनीम् सर्वाम् पातयन् च महान् द्रुमान् ।तमसा संवृतः सूर्यः सर्वे न वेदिषुर् दिशः ॥१-७४-१४॥
verses.transliteration: kampayan medinīm sarvām pātayan ca mahān drumān ।tamasā saṁvṛtaḥ sūryaḥ sarve na vediṣur diśaḥ ॥1-74-14॥

translations.english: While they were conversing, a storm blew, shaking the earth and felling down beautiful trees.
translations.hindi: F जो ह वालों में चतुर थे, राजा जनक से बोले--हमने यह पहले ही सुन रखा हे क्रि दान, दान दे “अधीन हे

verses.sloka: भस्मना च आवृतम् सर्वम् सम्मूढम् इव तत् बलम् ।वसिष्ठ ऋषयः च अन्ये राजा च ससुतः तदा ॥१-७४-१५॥
verses.transliteration: bhasmanā ca āvṛtam sarvam sammūḍham iva tat balam ।vasiṣṭha ṛṣayaḥ ca anye rājā ca sasutaḥ tadā ॥1-74-15॥

translations.english: The Sun was wrapped in dark. The quarters were devoid of brightness. The entire army was covered with ashes, as if they fainted.

verses.sloka: स संज्ञा इव तत्र आसन् सर्वम् अन्यत् विचेतनम् ।तस्मिन् तमसि घोरे तु भस्म छन्न इव सा चमूः ॥१-७४-१६॥
verses.transliteration: sa saṁjñā iva tatra āsan sarvam anyat vicetanam ।tasmin tamasi ghore tu bhasma channa iva sā camūḥ ॥1-74-16॥

translations.english: At that time Vasishta and other saints, the king and his sons held their senses under control. All others lost their consciousness.
translations.hindi: € हे घमेज्ञ ! अतः आप जैसा कहेंगे, ह ड हग, हम लोग वैसा ही करेंगे । “सत्यवादी महाराज दशरथ के ऐसे धर्मयुक्त औ ७ घमयु क्त -बचन ॥ (५॥ उक आर यश बढ़ाने वाले श्रुलरा विदेहाधिपतिः परं विस्मयमागतः । वतः सव मुनिंगशाः परस्परसमागमे

verses.sloka: ददर्श भीम संकाशम् जटा मण्डल धारिणम् ।भार्गवम् जमदग्ने अयम् राजा राज विमर्दनम् ॥१-७४-१७॥
verses.transliteration: dadarśa bhīma saṁkāśam jaṭā maṇḍala dhāriṇam ।bhārgavam jamadagne ayam rājā rāja vimardanam ॥1-74-17॥

translations.english: In that dreadful darkness while the army looked as if covered with ashes, king Dasaratha encountered the repressor of kings, descendant of Bhrugu and son of Jamadagni with a terrible crown of matted hair, inaccessible like Kailasa mountain and unendurable like the fire at the time of dissolution. The laymen gazing at his blazing energy,hanging an axe on his shoulder and holding a bow in his hand which flashed like lighning and the principal arrow he looked like Siva at the time of slaying of Tripura.
translations.hindi: बड़ी प्रसन्नता के साथ वहाँ रह कर रात बिताई। महाराज दशरथ भी अपने(पुत्रों ( श्रीरामचन्द्र और लक्ष्मण ) को देख, परम aes क ओर राजा जनक की खातिरदारी से सुखपूर्वक वहाँ वास (किया

verses.sloka: कैलासम् इव दुर्धर्षम् काल अग्निम् इव दुःसहम् ।ज्वलंतम् इव तेजोभिः दुर् निरीक्ष्यम् पृथक् जनैः ॥१-७४-१८॥
verses.transliteration: kailāsam iva durdharṣam kāla agnim iva duḥsaham ।jvalaṁtam iva tejobhiḥ dur nirīkṣyam pṛthak janaiḥ ॥1-74-18॥

translations.english: In that dreadful darkness while the army looked as if covered with ashes, king Dasaratha encountered the repressor of kings, descendant of Bhrugu and son of Jamadagni with a terrible crown of matted hair, inaccessible like Kailasa mountain and unendurable like the fire at the time of dissolution. The laymen gazing at his blazing energy,hanging an axe on his shoulder and holding a bow in his hand which flashed like lighning and the principal arrow he looked like Siva at the time of slaying of Tripura.
translations.hindi: जनको5पि महातेजाः क्रियां धमेण तत्तवित्‌ । यज्ञस्य च सुताभ्यां च कृत्वा रात्रिमुवास ह ।.१८॥ इति एकोनसप्ततितमः सर्ग; || उदार राजा जनक ने भी, यज्ञ और विवाह की करने -ीति भाँति को कर के, विश्राम किया

verses.sloka: स्कन्धे च आसज्य परशुम् धनुः विद्युत् गण उपमम् ।प्रगृह्य शरम् उग्रम् च त्रि पुर घ्नम् यथा शिवम् ॥१-७४-१९॥
verses.transliteration: skandhe ca āsajya paraśum dhanuḥ vidyut gaṇa upamam ।pragṛhya śaram ugram ca tri pura ghnam yathā śivam ॥1-74-19॥

translations.english: In that dreadful darkness while the army looked as if covered with ashes, king Dasaratha encountered the repressor of kings, descendant of Bhrugu and son of Jamadagni with a terrible crown of matted hair, inaccessible like Kailasa mountain and unendurable like the fire at the time of dissolution. The laymen gazing at his blazing energy,hanging an axe on his shoulder and holding a bow in his hand which flashed like lighning and the principal arrow he looked like Siva at the time of slaying of Tripura.

verses.sloka: तम् दृष्ट्वा भीम संकाशम् ज्वलंतम् इव पावकम् ।वसिष्ठ प्रमुखा विप्रा जप होम परायणाः ॥१-७४-२०॥
verses.transliteration: tam dṛṣṭvā bhīma saṁkāśam jvalaṁtam iva pāvakam ।vasiṣṭha pramukhā viprā japa homa parāyaṇāḥ ॥1-74-20॥

translations.english: In that dreadful darkness while the army looked as if covered with ashes, king Dasaratha encountered the repressor of kings, descendant of Bhrugu and son of Jamadagni with a terrible crown of matted hair, inaccessible like Kailasa mountain and unendurable like the fire at the time of dissolution. The laymen gazing at his blazing energy,hanging an axe on his shoulder and holding a bow in his hand which flashed like lighning and the principal arrow he looked like Siva at the time of slaying of Tripura.

verses.sloka: संगता मुनयः सर्वे संजजल्पुः अथो मिथः ।कच्चित् पितृ वध अमर्षी क्षत्रम् न उत्सादयिष्यति ॥१-७४-२१॥
verses.transliteration: saṁgatā munayaḥ sarve saṁjajalpuḥ atho mithaḥ ।kaccit pitṛ vadha amarṣī kṣatram na utsādayiṣyati ॥1-74-21॥

translations.english: At the sight of the fearful appearance of Parasurama looking like flaming fire, Vasishta and all other saints who were in the habit of chanting mantras and offering oblations to the fire whispered among themselves:

verses.sloka: पूर्वम् क्षत्र वधम् कृत्वा गत मन्युः गत ज्वरः ।क्षत्रस्य उत्सादनम् भूयो न खलु अस्य चिकीर्षितम् ॥१-७४-२२॥
verses.transliteration: pūrvam kṣatra vadham kṛtvā gata manyuḥ gata jvaraḥ ।kṣatrasya utsādanam bhūyo na khalu asya cikīrṣitam ॥1-74-22॥

translations.english: Enraged at the slaughter of his father (by Kartaveeryarjuna), is he intent upon exterminating the kshatriya race? Having slaughtered the kshatriyas, in the past he was freed from anger and grief. Is he again desirous of annihilating the kshatriyas?

verses.sloka: एवम् उक्त्वा अर्घ्यम् आदाय भार्गवम् भीम दर्शनम् ।ऋषयो राम राम इति मधुरम् वाक्यम् अब्रुवन् ॥१-७४-२३॥
verses.transliteration: evam uktvā arghyam ādāya bhārgavam bhīma darśanam ।ṛṣayo rāma rāma iti madhuram vākyam abruvan ॥1-74-23॥

translations.english: Enraged at the slaughter of his father (by Kartaveeryarjuna), is he intent upon exterminating the kshatriya race? Having slaughtered the kshatriyas, in the past he was freed from anger and grief. Is he again desirous of annihilating the kshatriyas?

verses.sloka: प्रतिगृह्य तु ताम् पूजाम् ऋषि दत्ताम् प्रतापवान् ।रामम् दाशरथिम् रामो जामदग्न्यो अभ्यभाषत ॥१-७४-२४॥
verses.transliteration: pratigṛhya tu tām pūjām ṛṣi dattām pratāpavān ।rāmam dāśarathim rāmo jāmadagnyo abhyabhāṣata ॥1-74-24॥

translations.english: The saints having thus talked amongst themselves, offered arghya to the son of Bhargava, of dreadful appearance and addressed him in soothing words: "O Rama O Rama".
